gen-gf-metamorphous-roboto-slab: Large sidebearings give Metamorphous a roomy, ceremonial stance. Roboto Slab sits beneath it, slab-serif and structured, so the two feel like a carved inscription handing off to a tidy ledger.
gen-righteous-gf-lexend-tera: Righteous bends its letters like thin steel rod, with bowls that fill the line and a swagger to match. And Lexend Tera answers in plotter-pen strokes, spaced like stepping stones, so the heading earns its keep when it's big and brief.
gen-gf-offside-bitter: Offside spreads its letters wide, with curves that refuse to close and a level beat. But Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye, grounds the page with strokes you can follow comfortably for paragraphs.
gen-gf-offside-inter: Wide-tracked and left open, with curves that never quite close, Offside sets a confident, expressive tone up top. Inter's tube-like lines stay out of the way.
gen-audiowide-mulish: Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, giving the heading a futuristic, tech-flavored hum. Mulish takes over below with soft, horseshoe-open curves and a big x-height, so the page feels modern and approachable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-rubik: Rubik's lowercase looks big beside its capitals, and its round letters stay open and soft. But Funnel Display shrunk to a small size would lose its spaghetti-like strokes and the commanding presence they give.
gen-gf-offside-roboto-slab: No calligraphic swelling touches Offside; every outline stays smooth and level. Roboto Slab, precise and slab-serif, adds structure beneath, and that tension between loose spacing and tight order is the pair's best trait.
gen-eater-mulish: Dark, jagged, a bit menacing, Eater has strokes that taper only slightly, like a candle flame. Mulish is the sans-serif that calms it down, with pipe-cleaner strokes and open apertures that feel friendly.
gen-gf-oxanium-bitter: Oxanium's high x-height makes its lowercase look big and bold. It does the shouting with uninterrupted monoline strokes, while Bitter, a slab-serif with see-through s shapes, handles the quiet, grounded talking.
gen-gf-grandstander-rubik: Grandstander keeps its lines constant in width, even in the g, with a tall x-height and short ascenders that feel playful and bold. Rubik's soft roundness is the pair's real strength.
